git rev-parse HEAD
$taskGitHeadExit=$LASTEXITCODE

git diff --cached --name-only
$taskGitIndexExit=$LASTEXITCODE

if ($taskGitStatusExit -ne 0) {exit $taskGitStatusExit}
if ($taskGitBranchExit -ne 0) {exit $taskGitBranchExit}
if ($taskGitHeadExit -ne 0) {exit $taskGitHeadExit}
exit $taskGitIndexExit
